test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**froun**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**froun**'. • Its correct spelling is '**frown**'. • It means **'to show you are angry, serious, etc. by making lines appear on your forehead above your nose'. **(ऐसे क्रोध प्रदर्शित करना कि माथे पर रेखाएँ दिखाई देने लगें; भौंहें तन जाना, त्‍योरी चढ़ना) • *Example: Harmony's **frown** was fierce.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Froth**: a mass of small white bubbles on the top of a liquid, etc. (द्रव आदि पर छोटे सफ़ेद बुलबुलों का ढेर; झाग) • **Friend**: a person that you know and like (not a member of your family), and who likes you. [मित्र, दोस्‍त (जो परिवार का सदस्‍य नहीं है)] • **Frozen**: (of a liquid) having turned into ice as a result of extreme cold. [जमा हुआ; (एक तरल का) अत्यधिक ठंड के परिणामस्वरूप बर्फ में बदल जाना] 31:T135b, The correct answer is **'lengthy but not'.**
